title: Lime Juice and Zest Cubes
equip: None (no cooking); 15ml-cell silicone tray with lid

steps.x: Wash and dry the limes. Zest all 10 with a fine grater, green part only (the white pith is bitter). If you have no grater, peel the green with a vegetable peeler and mince it finely.
Roll each lime firmly on the counter, cut and squeeze. Strain out the seeds. You should have about 300 ml.
Stir the zest into the juice.
Fill the 15 ml cells, stirring the juice between spoonfuls so the zest is spread evenly. Freeze for 2 h until solid. Pop out, bag, press out the air and label with name and date.

notes: Use 1 cube (15 ml) per curry or dal for 4-5 portions. Add it at the end, off the heat. Heat and pressure dull the brightness, so never add it before pressure cooking.
For raita, chutney and fresh finishing squeezes, fresh lime still tastes better.
Freezer life: 3 months. Calamansi seeds are bitter, so strain thoroughly.
